cells.scene: An adult traveler walks steadily on foot along a rough country path, worn boots, small pack and determined stride.
A sailor ties a boat's thick rope securely around a dock bollard, boat floating gently beside the quay.
A small village straggles along a winding road, houses scattered irregularly with gaps between them rather than compact blocks.
A neglected old house has a sagging roof, cracked walls, broken shutters and missing tiles, no occupants in danger.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — tramp (v.徒步行进): An adult traveler walks steadily on foot along a rough country path, worn boots, small pack and determined stride.
TOP RIGHT — moor (v.(用绳、链、锚)系(船)): A sailor ties a boat's thick rope securely around a dock bollard, boat floating gently beside the quay.
BOTTOM LEFT — straggle (v.蔓延，散乱分布): A small village straggles along a winding road, houses scattered irregularly with gaps between them rather than compact blocks.
BOTTOM RIGHT — dilapidated (a.陈旧破烂的，倒塌的): A neglected old house has a sagging roof, cracked walls, broken shutters and missing tiles, no occupants in danger.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: walking traveler depicts tramp; sailor fastens mooring rope; houses spread irregularly along road depict straggle; broken neglected house is dilapidated. Main actions and safe white cell margins are clear.
